action: Check the validation exit status and end the script on nonzero before invoking the mutation; use explicit early exit or a guarded shell && chain. Keep independent read batching separate.
trigger: A tool orchestration validates text before a dependent publication or mutation
why: The first PR15 body lint found an untagged phrase, but the next tool call still created the PR because the orchestrator did not inspect exit_code. The corrected body and consumer update use an explicit guard.
